eyebrow: A real difference from Foundations Lesson 43
code:
# Foundations: nullable=False was just a HINT --
#              Spark generally still loaded a bad null.
#
# Delta: a schema mismatch FAILS THE WRITE OUTRIGHT.
#        A real, enforced guardrail. Not a hint.
caption: Delta actually does what that StructField flag only pretended to.

code:
new_data = spark.createDataFrame(
  [("2", 14.5, "extra_value")],
  ["VendorID", "fare_amount", "unexpected_column"],
)

new_data.write.format("delta").mode("append").save(path)

caption: Extra columns, missing columns, incompatible type changes -- all rejected by default.

eyebrow: Why this matters — Consistency, made concrete
code:
# Lesson 18's Consistency guarantee, visible here:
# nobody can silently corrupt a table's shape
# with one bad write.
#
# Compare: a malformed CSV row -> a silent null (Lesson 48)
caption: Schema enforcement is Delta's answer to exactly that CSV-reading risk.
